file: Skills For Real ReactReact Native Engineers-1.7.1-v2.zip

plugins.name: hzblj-skills
plugins.description: Skills for React/React Native Engineers. Straight from my .claude directory.

skills.name: reanimated-core
skills.description: Reanimated core — useSharedValue, useAnimatedStyle, useDerivedValue, useAnimatedReaction, useAnimatedProps, worklet rules, UI vs JS thread, runOnUI/runOnJS, and the .value-only-in-worklets rule. Triggers on: shared value, useAnimatedStyle, worklet, runOnJS, UI thread, .value in render.
headings: The golden rule: never touch `.value` during render
What worklets can and can't capture
skills.description_zh: 提供 Reanimated 核心规则，涵盖共享值、useAnimatedStyle、useDerivedValue、useAnimatedReaction、useAnimatedProps、worklet、UI/JS 线程及 runOnUI/runOnJS。原说明强调 .value 仅在 worklet 使用，适用于共享值和渲染线程问题。

skills.name: reanimated-gestures
skills.description: Reanimated + gesture-handler v2 — Gesture.Pan/Tap/Pinch, GestureDetector, driving shared values, withDecay, runOnJS, gesture composition, activeOffset/failOffset. Triggers on: gesture, pan, swipe, drag, GestureDetector, withDecay, pinch.
headings: Driving shared values: the offset pattern
`runOnJS`: state, navigation, haptics from a gesture
skills.description_zh: 指导 Reanimated 与 gesture-handler v2 配合，涵盖 Pan、Tap、Pinch、GestureDetector、共享值驱动、withDecay、runOnJS、手势组合及 activeOffset/failOffset。适用于拖动、滑动和缩放。

skills.name: reanimated-layout-animations
skills.description: Reanimated layout animations — entering/exiting presets, custom builders, LinearTransition/CurvedTransition, Keyframe, LayoutAnimationConfig, itemLayoutAnimation. The first choice for enter/exit. Triggers on: entering, exiting, FadeIn, layout animation, LinearTransition, list item animation.
skills.description_zh: 使用 Reanimated 布局动画处理进入退出效果，涵盖预设、自定义构建器、LinearTransition、CurvedTransition、Keyframe、LayoutAnimationConfig 和 itemLayoutAnimation。原说明将其列为进入退出动画首选。

skills.name: reanimated-text-and-numbers
skills.description: Reanimated animated text and numbers — the useAnimatedProps + TextInput (ReText) pattern, animated counters, per-character staggered reveals, tabular figures, blur/opacity mount reveal. Triggers on: animate number, animated counter, ReText, animate text, typewriter, tabular nums.
skills.description_zh: 通过 useAnimatedProps 与 TextInput/ReText 模式实现 Reanimated 文字和数字动画，涵盖计数器、逐字符错峰显示、等宽数字及模糊透明度入场。

skills.name: reanimated-timing
skills.description: Reanimated timing — withTiming vs withSpring vs withDecay, Easing, spring configs, withSequence/withDelay/withRepeat, cancelAnimation, reduced motion, recommended constant configs. Triggers on: withSpring, withTiming, easing, damping stiffness, withRepeat, reduced motion.
headings: Recommended constant configs (copy into a shared module)
skills.description_zh: 指导 Reanimated 动画时间与物理参数，比较 withTiming、withSpring、withDecay，配置 Easing、弹簧、序列、延迟、重复、取消及减少动态效果，并推荐固定配置。

skills.name: skia
skills.description: Opinionated rules for @shopify/react-native-skia in Expo + TypeScript — the declarative <Canvas> API (Circle/Rect/Path/Group/Paint/gradients/Blur), driving animation from Reanimated shared values with useDerivedValue and useClock, runtime SkSL shaders, on-canvas text/images, and the GPU-vs-CPU cost of every effect — so custom graphics render on the GPU without faking them with nested Views. Triggers on: Skia, Canvas, shader, SkSL, RuntimeEffect, Path, Paint, gradient, Blur, useClock, useImage, useFont, chart/graph, custom drawing, GPU effect, Picture.
headings: When to reach for Skia (and when not to)
skills.description_zh: 指导 Expo 和 TypeScript 中的 @shopify/react-native-skia，使用声明式 Canvas 图形、共享值、useDerivedValue/useClock、运行时 SkSL 着色器和画布文字图片，并分析 GPU 与 CPU 效果成本。适用于自定义绘图、图表和 GPU 特效。

skills.name: react-navigation
skills.description: React Navigation setup, typed routes, navigator structure, deep linking, and navigation actions. Use when building or modifying navigation in React Native. Triggers on: React Navigation, navigation, typed routes, navigator, stack navigator, tab navigator, deep linking, useNavigation, screen options.
skills.description_zh: 配置或修改 React Native 的 React Navigation，涵盖类型化路由、导航器结构、深层链接、导航动作及屏幕选项。

skills.name: native-feel
skills.description: Opinionated rules for making an Expo + TypeScript app feel genuinely native on both platforms — a strict spacing/design-token system, Platform.OS/Platform.select branching, expo-haptics (impact/selection/notification) used with restraint, per-platform Pressable feedback, safe areas and edge-to-edge, keyboard handling, scroll feel, Dynamic Type and accessibility, dark mode, and reduced motion. Triggers on: Platform.select, expo-haptics, impactAsync, selectionAsync, notificationAsync, android_ripple, safe area insets, edge-to-edge, KeyboardAvoidingView, useColorScheme, dark mode, hitSlop, touch target, VoiceOver, TalkBack, reduced motion, spacing tokens.
skills.description_zh: 指导 Expo 和 TypeScript 应用实现双平台原生体验，涵盖间距设计令牌、平台分支、适度触觉反馈、Pressable、安全区、全面屏、键盘、滚动、动态字体、无障碍、深色模式和减少动态效果。

skills.name: lists
skills.description: Strict performance rules for lists — FlashList, stable renderItem, extracted item components, and naming patterns. Use when building or optimizing list views. Triggers on: FlashList, FlatList, renderItem, estimatedItemSize, list performance, list item component, list naming.
skills.description_zh: 提供列表性能规则，涵盖 FlashList、稳定 renderItem、独立列表项组件和命名模式。适用于列表构建及优化。

skills.name: comments
skills.description: Clean-code comments — explain why not how, delete redundant and dead comments, prefer self-explaining code. Use when writing or reviewing comments and docs. Triggers on: comment, commented-out code, TODO, TSDoc, why not how, dead code.
headings: Good comments protect from well-meaning mistakes
No commented-out code, changelogs, attributions, or author tags — git handles all of it
When a comment IS worth it vs. when it is NOT
skills.description_zh: 按整洁代码原则编写或审查注释和文档，解释原因、删除重复及失效注释，优先让代码自解释。适用于 TODO、TSDoc 和注释掉的代码。

skills.name: error-handling
skills.description: Clean-code error handling — exceptions over error codes, wrap third-party APIs at a boundary, don''t use catch as an if, don''t return or pass null. Use when designing failure paths and error boundaries. Triggers on: error handling, exceptions, try catch, error codes, wrap library, throw, return null, empty array, null checks.
headings: Wrap third-party APIs — don't catch a library's exceptions directly
Don't return `null` — throw, or return an empty collection
skills.description_zh: 提供整洁代码的错误处理规则，主张异常优于错误码、在边界包装第三方 API、不把 catch 当条件分支，以及不返回或传递 null。适用于失败路径和错误边界设计。

skills.name: formatting
skills.description: Clean-code formatting — vertical ordering (stepdown/newspaper), declaring near use, team-enforced tooling. Use when ordering or formatting code. Triggers on: formatting, code order, Prettier, ESLint, vertical spacing, where to declare variables.
headings: Vertical ordering — the newspaper / stepdown rule
The simplest formatting rules do the most heavy lifting
Declare variables close to their usage; group class properties in one place; let the team decide the rest
skills.description_zh: 指导代码排序和格式，涵盖从高层到细节的纵向组织、变量靠近使用处声明及团队统一格式工具。适用于 Prettier、ESLint、代码顺序和间距。

skills.name: functions
skills.description: Clean-code functions — small, do one thing, one abstraction level, few arguments, no side effects, command-query separation, plus DRY and refactor discipline. Use when writing or reviewing functions. Triggers on: function too long, do one thing, too many arguments, side effects, command query, DRY, extract function, refactor.
headings: Do One Thing — Tell a Story
One Level of Abstraction Per Function
Reasons a Function Takes a Single Argument
Group Related Arguments Into Objects — Watch Pairs and Triads
Leave it cleaner than you found it
skills.description_zh: 按整洁代码原则编写和评审函数，强调短小、单一职责、统一抽象层、少参数、无副作用、命令查询分离、DRY 及有纪律的重构。

skills.name: meaningful-names
skills.description: Clean-code naming — intention-revealing, honest, distinct, pronounceable, searchable names with no type encoding. Use when naming or reviewing variables, functions, types, and components. Triggers on: naming, rename, meaningful names, magic number, Hungarian notation, unclear name.
headings: Don't Encode Types Into Names — Let the Tooling Handle Types
skills.description_zh: 为变量、函数、类型及组件选择表达意图、真实、可区分、可读和可搜索的名称，避免类型编码。适用于重命名、魔法数字及含糊名称审查。

skills.name: objects-and-data
skills.description: Clean-code objects vs. data structures — Tell Don''t Ask, object/data anti-symmetry, Law of Demeter, contract-first design. Use when designing types, classes, and module boundaries. Triggers on: encapsulation, Tell Don''t Ask, Law of Demeter, train wreck, DTO vs class, interface first.
headings: Expose behavior, not data (Tell, Don't Ask)
Objects vs. data structures — pick the right tool
Data/Object anti-symmetry — pick a side, your class can't be both
Law of Demeter — stop chaining through strangers
Define the contract before you write the logic
Objects vs. Data Structures — decision table
skills.description_zh: 指导对象与数据结构设计，涵盖 Tell Don't Ask、对象数据反对称性、迪米特法则和契约优先。适用于封装、DTO 与类的选择及模块边界。

skills.name: hooks
skills.description: Rules for custom hooks — naming, logic extraction, and separation of view and logic. Use when creating or refactoring hooks. Triggers on: custom hook, use prefix, extract logic into hook, separate view and logic, move state out of component.
skills.description_zh: 指导自定义 React hook 的命名、逻辑提取及视图与逻辑分离，适用于创建重构 hook 或将状态从组件移出。

skills.name: how
skills.description: Use for "how does X work", code walkthroughs before changing something, and placement / ownership / layering questions ("where should this live", "which package owns this", "is this the right layer"). Explains subsystem architecture, runtime flow, onboarding mental models. Can critique architecture. Use why for motivation.
headings: Step 1. Understand the Question and Assess Complexity
skills.description_zh: 解释子系统架构、运行流程和入门理解，适用于修改前代码导览及代码位置、包责任和分层问题，也可评价架构；设计动机转用 why。

skills.name: orchestration
skills.description: Tiered multi-agent orchestration — an expensive model plans and synthesizes while specialized subagents do the work in their own isolated contexts. Covers the agent tiers, routing rules, why context isolation saves tokens, parallel fan-out, and the cost model. Use when a task spans multiple files or steps, or when deciding which agent should do what. Triggers on: orchestrate, delegate, subagent, multi-agent, which agent, model tier, deep-reasoner, fast-worker, token budget, context isolation, plan and delegate, cost.
headings: Why it saves — the real mechanism
skills.description_zh: 指导分层多智能体编排，由成本较高的模型规划和综合、专项子智能体在隔离上下文中执行，涵盖路由、并行分发、上下文隔离及成本模型。适用于跨文件多步骤任务和智能体分工选择。

skills.name: project
skills.description: Monorepo project structure — Turborepo layout with packages/core-*, packages/platform-*, packages/feature-*, and deployable apps (mobile, web, backend, e2e), dependency direction, package boundaries, public-API exports, and per-package internal structure. Use when creating packages/features/apps, wiring dependencies, or structuring a module. Triggers on: monorepo, turborepo, package, core-, feature-, platform-, apps, index.ts, public API, deep import, dependency direction, workspace.
skills.description_zh: 指导 Turborepo 单仓结构，组织 core、platform、feature 包及 mobile、web、backend、e2e 应用，明确依赖方向、包边界、公开 API 和包内结构。适用于新建包、功能、应用及连接依赖。

skills.name: teach
skills.description: Explain a body of work plainly so a person actually understands it. Runs the `how` and `why` skills and weaves what they find into one clear explanation. Use for 'teach me this', 'help me really understand X', 'explain this change or subsystem to me'.
skills.description_zh: 结合 how 和 why 的发现，用清晰语言讲解一项工作、变更或子系统，帮助用户理解机制和设计原因。

skills.name: type-safety
skills.description: Strict TypeScript typing — type over interface, no any, no as casts, narrow literal unions, discriminated unions, constructive modeling, exhaustive switch with never, satisfies, branded types, boundary validation, and safe array indexing. Use when defining, composing, or reviewing types. Triggers on: type over interface, no any, no enum, unknown, as cast, narrow types, string-literal union, discriminated union, constructive modeling, NonEmpty, exhaustiveness, never, assertNever, satisfies, as const, keyof, typeof, utility types, Pick, Omit, Record, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, array indexing, branded type, narrowing hierarchy, type guard, boundary validation, schema-derived types, object args, type safety.
skills.description_zh: 提供严格 TypeScript 类型规则，主张 type 优先、避免 any 和 as 转换，采用窄字面量联合、判别联合、构造性建模、never 穷尽检查、satisfies、品牌类型、边界校验及安全数组索引。适用于类型定义、组合及审查。

skills.name: atomic-design
skills.description: Structure the UI library (core-ui) with Atomic Design — atoms, molecules, organisms, templates — where composition flows one way (higher composes lower). Covers which level a component belongs to, the file/folder conventions, and the promotion policy: obvious primitives (Button, Input) go straight into core-ui/atoms, but feature-specific UI stays local to its feature until it''s needed in a second place, then it''s promoted down into core-ui and generalized. Use when organizing a component library, deciding where a component lives, or extracting a shared component. Triggers on: atomic design, atoms, molecules, organisms, templates, core-ui, design system, ui library, component library, where does this component go, promote component, extract to core-ui, when to extract, rule of three, premature abstraction, component reuse.
headings: Where does a new component go?
Promote on the second use — not before
skills.description_zh: 按原子设计组织 core-ui 的 atoms、molecules、organisms 和 templates，高层仅组合低层。Button、Input 等基础组件直接入共享库，功能专属 UI 先留本地，第二处需要时再下沉并泛化；涵盖文件约定和组件提升策略。

skills.name: component-architecture
skills.description: Defines component structure, prop typing, responsibility separation, and ref handling patterns. Use when creating or refactoring React components. Triggers on: component structure, FC, prop type, forwardRef, ref handling, split component, responsibility separation.
skills.description_zh: 定义 React 组件结构、props 类型、职责分离和 ref 处理模式，适用于组件创建及重构。

skills.name: compound-components
skills.description: Build flexible components as a compound/composer set — namespaced parts (Tabs.Item, WizardCard.Provider) that share one context, exposed via Object.assign or an object literal. Covers the context + guard-hook pattern, memoizing the context value, the controlled/uncontrolled hybrid, exposing the raw Provider so the state source can be lifted all the way up to a global hook, and the state / actions / meta context convention where meta holds refs and non-reactive handles. Use when a component has several parts that share state or the consumer needs to arrange those parts freely. Triggers on: compound component, composer component, Object.assign component, namespaced component, dot-notation component, sub-components, Tabs.Item, expose Provider, lift state up, state actions meta, refs in meta, shared context, controlled uncontrolled, useContext guard.
headings: Why a composer, not a wall of props
The minimal shape: context + guard hook
The Root — owns state, provides context, memoizes the value
Controlled or uncontrolled — lift state up only when you need to
Scaling up: the composer, with a `state` / `actions` / `meta` context
Expose the `Provider` so the state source can be lifted all the way up
skills.description_zh: 构建共享上下文的复合组件，以 Tabs.Item 等命名空间部件供使用者自由布局，通过 Object.assign 或对象导出。涵盖保护性 hook、上下文值记忆化、受控非受控混合、原始 Provider 暴露、状态提升及 state/actions/meta 约定，其中 meta 保存 ref 和非响应句柄。

skills.name: ui-interactions
skills.description: Cross-platform interaction polish — press/tap feedback (scale 0.96), haptics, hover, focus rings, disabled/loading, minimum hit area, no transition:all, will-change. Triggers on: press feedback, scale on press, haptics, ripple, hover, focus-visible, active state.
headings: When to fire (and when not to)
Web — CSS transitions don't replay; gate keyframes
When to Animate / When Not To
skills.description_zh: 完善跨平台交互反馈，涵盖按压缩放 0.96、触觉、悬停、焦点环、禁用加载状态、最小点击区域及 will-change；原说明不使用 transition:all。

skills.name: ui-motion
skills.description: Cross-platform motion polish — interruptible animations, split & stagger enter, subtle exit, contextual icon cross-fade, skip-animation-on-load. Web uses CSS/Tailwind + GSAP (no motion library). Triggers on: stagger, enter animation, exit animation, icon cross-fade, interruptible, GSAP stagger, skip animation on first load.
skills.description_zh: 完善跨平台动效，涵盖可中断动画、分组错峰入场、轻微退出、上下文图标交叉淡入和首次加载跳过动画。网页采用 CSS/Tailwind 与 GSAP，不使用其他 motion 库。

skills.name: performance
skills.description: Enforces rendering performance best practices — memoization, stable references, and avoiding unnecessary re-renders. Use when optimizing component performance. Triggers on: re-render, useMemo, useCallback, memoization, stable reference, inline arrow in JSX, inline object prop.
skills.description_zh: 优化组件渲染性能，使用记忆化和稳定引用，避免不必要重渲染。适用于 useMemo、useCallback、JSX 内联函数和内联对象 props。

skills.name: ui-surfaces
skills.description: Cross-platform surfaces polish — concentric border radius, optical alignment, shadows vs. elevation, image outlines, minimum hit areas. Triggers on: concentric radius, optical alignment, box-shadow, elevation, image outline, hitSlop, hit area.
headings: When to Use Shadows vs. Borders (both platforms)
skills.description_zh: 完善跨平台界面表面表现，涵盖同心圆角、视觉对齐、阴影与 elevation、图片轮廓及最小点击区域。

skills.name: ui-typography
skills.description: Cross-platform (React web + React Native) typography polish — text-wrap balance/pretty, font smoothing, tabular numbers, Dynamic Type, adjustsFontSizeToFit, letter spacing, layout-shift avoidance. Triggers on: text wrapping, tabular numbers, font smoothing, Dynamic Type, adjustsFontSizeToFit, orphan.
skills.description_zh: 完善 React 网页及 React Native 排版，涵盖平衡换行、字体平滑、等宽数字、Dynamic Type、自动字体适配、字距及避免布局跳动。

skills.name: unslop
skills.description: Cut AI tells from writing and put a real voice back in. Use when drafting or editing any prose: READMEs, docs, commit messages, PR descriptions, changelogs, release notes, code comments, blog posts. Triggers on: unslop, slop, AI tells, sounds like AI, robotic, em dash, delve, tapestry, prose, writing style, tone of voice, README, PR description, commit message.
skills.description_zh: 删除写作中的模板化 AI 表达并恢复作者声音，适用于 README、文档、提交信息、PR、变更日志、版本说明、代码注释及博客的起草和编辑。

skills.name: why
skills.description: Investigate why code is the way it is — design rationale, rejected alternatives, the incident or customer that forced a threshold. Use when the question is about motivation and history rather than mechanics. Enumerates the available evidence sources (git/gh, issue tracker, long-form docs, team chat, observability, error tracking, analytics warehouse), queries them in parallel with one subagent each, and returns a cited, confidence-calibrated read with the gaps named. Triggers on: why does this work this way, why did we pick, design rationale, historical context, archaeology, git blame, postmortem, regression, where did this number come from, rejected alternatives, tradeoffs, decision record, who decided, what forced this.
headings: Step 1 — Understand the target and the question
Last-touch commits for the exact lines in question
Full history through renames, with patches
Recent commits touching the file, PR numbers visible in the subjects
The full message of one commit — linked tickets usually live here
Step 3 — Discover the sources, then fan out
skills.description_zh: 调查代码设计动机及历史，包括选择原因、被拒方案、事故或客户如何促成阈值。按 Git/GitHub、工单、文档、团队聊天、可观测性、错误追踪及分析仓库等证据来源并行安排子智能体查询，输出带引用、置信度和缺口的解释。

skills.name: css-animations
skills.description: Pure-CSS web animations best practices — interruptible transitions vs. keyframes, staggered enter, subtle exit, icon cross-fade with no motion library, scale-on-press, transition specificity, will-change, and prefers-reduced-motion. Use for web motion that doesn''t need a JS timeline (reach for GSAP when it does). Triggers on: CSS transition, keyframes, animation-delay, stagger, will-change, transition all, reduced motion, scale on press, icon cross-fade, cubic-bezier.
headings: Icon Cross-Fade Without a Motion Library
skills.description_zh: 指导不需 JavaScript 时间线的纯 CSS 动画，涵盖可中断过渡、关键帧、错峰入场、轻微退出、图标交叉淡入、按压缩放、明确过渡属性、will-change 及减少动态效果。需要时间线时使用 GSAP。

skills.name: gsap-performance
skills.description: GSAP performance — animate transform/opacity only, extract duration/easing constants, will-change, force3D, ScrollTrigger perf, prefers-reduced-motion. Use when optimizing web animations. Triggers on: jank, will-change, transform opacity, reduced motion, gsap performance.
headings: Extract Duration and Easing into Constants
skills.description_zh: 优化 GSAP 动画性能，限定 transform/opacity 动画、提取时长和缓动常量，并处理 will-change、force3D、ScrollTrigger 性能及减少动态效果。

skills.name: gsap-react
skills.description: GSAP with React/Next.js — the useGSAP hook, scope, contextSafe, automatic cleanup, plugin registration, never animating React state, SSR. Use when wiring GSAP into React. Triggers on: useGSAP, gsap.context, cleanup, contextSafe, registerPlugin, next.js use client.
skills.description_zh: 在 React/Next.js 中接入 GSAP，涵盖 useGSAP、scope、contextSafe、自动清理、插件注册及 SSR，原说明要求不直接对 React state 做动画。

skills.name: gsap-scroll-trigger
skills.description: GSAP ScrollTrigger — trigger/start/end, scrub, pin, toggleActions, snap, batch, responsive matchMedia, cleanup. Use for scroll-linked web animations. Triggers on: ScrollTrigger, scroll animation, scrub, pin, parallax, markers.
skills.description_zh: 使用 GSAP ScrollTrigger 构建滚动关联动画，配置 trigger/start/end、scrub、pin、toggleActions、snap、batch、响应式 matchMedia 和清理。

skills.name: gsap-text
skills.description: GSAP SplitText type/text animations — split into chars/words/lines, staggered reveals, line masking, font readiness, revert for a11y, reduced motion. Use for animated text reveals. Triggers on: SplitText, text reveal, type animation, word stagger, line mask.
skills.description_zh: 使用 GSAP SplitText 将文字拆为字符、词或行，制作错峰显示和行遮罩，并处理字体加载、无障碍恢复及减少动态效果。

skills.name: gsap-timelines
skills.description: GSAP 3 timelines — sequencing, defaults, labels, relative position, stagger, repeat/yoyo, control methods, nesting. Use when building sequenced web animations. Triggers on: gsap timeline, sequence, stagger, labels, yoyo, timeScale.
headings: Build with `defaults`, One Tween per Line
skills.description_zh: 通过 GSAP 3 时间线编排网页动画，涵盖顺序、默认值、标签、相对位置、错峰、重复/yoyo、控制方法和嵌套。

skills.name: nextjs-routing
skills.description: Next.js App Router patterns — route structure, layouts, server vs client components, dynamic routes, loading/error states, metadata, and navigation. Use when building or modifying routing. Triggers on: App Router, route, layout, server component, client component, dynamic route, loading.tsx, error.tsx, metadata, useRouter, Link.

skills.name: tailwind
